content:
Seriously, if you like pasta and want to spend part of your vacation in Búzios, follow the great tip to enjoy lunch **and** dinner: Donatello Pasta.

Donatello Pasta specializes in the best pasta in the region (believe me), I went there the first time and fell in love! The Chef of the house, Felipe Peracio, can make a dish in an average of 2 minutes! No more waiting for your food.
